overallFeel: The video maintains high perceived production value through continuous micro-motion, tactile spring physics, and deep 2.5D card layering. Nothing rests completely: elements float with organic dampening, UI mockups tilt in 3D perspective, and scene transitions rely on seamless spatial push or zoom reveals rather than hard cuts.

pacing.whatCountsAsAChange: Headline text swap, card flip/tilt perspective shift, dock tab icon activation, counter tick-up, camera push-in, UI mockup interaction demonstration
pacing.isAnythingEverFullyStill: no - every scene maintains a subtle ambient 2% to 4% continuous camera scale drift, breathing card rotations (0.5deg to 1.5deg), or floating glow pulses

cards.description: Floating glassmorphic app windows, browser cards with top address bar, code editor panels, and phone mockups
cards.border: thin light, 1.5px semi-transparent white/highlight border (inset 1px border highlight)

shadow.layers: stacked: 0px 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2) base drop + 0px 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) ambient floor

cards.tiltOr3dRotation: perspective 1200px, rotateY: -16deg to 18deg, rotateX: 6deg to 10deg, slight z-translation (+60px to +120px)
cards.idleMotionAfterEntrance: slow float / figure-8 drift: translateY oscillating +/- 8px over 90 frames (3000ms), rotateZ oscillating +/- 0.8deg

pills.description: Dock navigation bar, category badges, and tag chips (e.g. GitHub star counters, dev tool command pills)
pills.fill: glass-blur (backdrop-filter blur 18px, 12% fill opacity with subtle top inner border)
pills.iconInside: yes, centered or aligned left with 8px margin to text
pills.shadowOrGlow: soft diffused radial back-glow (30px radius, 25% opacity) matching the active accent color
pills.entrance: Scale up from 0.82 to 1.05 with overshoot over 14 frames (467ms), opacity 0 to 1 in 8 frames (267ms), spring damping 14

text.fontCharacter: geometric clean sans-serif with tall x-height and tight kerning
text.emphasis: color contrast tint (bright brand accent vs pure white), accompanied by a synchronized scale punch (+4% scale pop)
text.exitAnimation: slide up 18px while fading to 0 opacity over 8 frames (267ms)
text.syncWithVoice: words pop in exactly 1-2 frames before the audio onset phoneme of each word

entrances.animation: slide from bottom with 3D tilt reveal
entrances.overshoot: yes, scale reaches 1.03 before settling to 1.0

entrances.animation: vertical slot-machine roll and number interpolation
pop and snap into active dock tray slot
slide right with sequential checkmark trigger
radial bloom expand from trigger point
zoom push through z-axis with perspective flip

lists: List items cascade from top to bottom with a 4-frame offset. Each row enters with an X-offset of -40px sliding to 0px, while an accompanying status icon scales in from 0 with an overshoot bounce (scale 1.25 -> 1.0) on frame 8 of each item's arrival.
diagrams: Bezier curves and layout bounding boxes are drawn on using stroke-dashoffset transitions (18 frames duration). Node labels and coordinate handles pop up via 0-to-1 scale springs right as the stroke passes their coordinate point.
counters: Numbers animate using an interpolated value counter over 22-26 frames (733ms - 867ms). The counter starts rapidly, decellerates smoothly into the final target integer, while the accompanying star/metric icon pulses up by +12% scale at the moment of numerical completion.

transitionsBetweenScenes.howOftenUsed: Used between consecutive tool presentations (4 times)
Used when diving into code editor view or UI inspection detail (3 times)
Dock icons switch active state on every tool chapter change

camera: Continuous subtle dolly-in (slow zoom from 1.00 to 1.04 over 60-90 frame scene stretches). When high-impact keywords land, a sharp 2-frame camera zoom punch (+3% scale) immediately eases back down over 8 frames.
backgroundMotion: A soft ambient chromatic radial gradient orb drifts laterally in the background (+/- 80px horizontal wander over 150 frames) with subtle brightness breathing (opacity oscillating between 0.35 and 0.55).
depthAndLayers: Constructed across 4 distinct spatial planes: (1) Background drift gradient; (2) Mid-ground UI context window with heavy blur (backdrop-filter 24px); (3) Foreground focal card tilted in 3D with sharp drop shadows; (4) Floating persistent dock and top headline placed in screen-space overlay.
soundSync: Whoosh transitions fire exactly 2 frames before visual scene cuts. Click/snap sounds lock 1:1 onto dock pill switch events. Subtitle pop hits trigger subtle sub-bass thumps on emphasised keywords.
top5TechniquesToCopy: Persistent floating dock navigation bar with spring-animated active indicator pill showing progress through the 5 items.
3D perspective card tilt (perspective: 1200px, rotateY: 15deg, rotateX: 8deg) with layered ambient shadows to prevent flat UI look.
Fast staggered word pop-in text with spring scale (0.9 to 1.04 overshoot) synced tightly to spoken emphasis words.
Numeric star/stat rollups with decelerating interpolation easing and an end-of-roll scale pop.
Camera micro-push (+3-4% continuous scale drift over every scene) so the canvas never feels frozen or static.
